decisions: parse_run_id's return arity: normal ids return a 3-tuple (date, hms, sha), matching the exact 3-tuple unpacking in prioritize-proposals' frozen test_priorities_paths.py; a D8 collision-suffixed id returns a 4-tuple with the suffix appended as the 4th element.
